author: Praxis I
title: Dual-BRBG-Whitened: k=46 (PCA64, tau=0.95, AdaptPC)
abstract: Micro-sweep on degree: k=46 with ComBat-PCA64 soft-whitened embedding (alpha=0.95) and adaptive per-PC residualized graph. Goal: check if slight degree increase beats k=45 SOTA 0.7296.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from praxis.dual_whitened_adaptpc import run_pipeline
import anndata as ad

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return run_pipeline(adata,
                        n_pcs_emb=64, alpha=0.95,
                        n_pcs_graph=50, gamma_max=0.74, lam=0.9, l2=1e-3,
                        k_total=46, metric='cosine')
